name: Larsen & Toubro
narrative: Management missed its full-year FY26 revenue growth target of 15%, reporting 12%, and missed its Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA margin target of 8.5% at 7.8%. However, working capital to revenue exceeded the 10% target at 4.1%, and Q2 FY27 net profit grew 27.2%.

promises.statement: Management retains reasonable confidence of achieving full year FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15%.

said.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%

actual_source.quote: Full year revenue growth guidance, FY26: 11.8%
actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Target for Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA margin for FY26 is 8.5%.

said.quote: in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26

actual_source.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well

promises.note: Full-year FY26 Projects and Manufacturing margin reached 7.8% against the 8.5% target.

promises.statement: Management expects to exceed the 10% order inflow growth guidance for FY26.

said.quote: we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26

actual_source.quote: Our nine months order inflow has seen a strong growth of 30% Y-on-Y based on a strong capex momentum

promises.note: Nine-month FY26 order inflows grew 30% year-on-year, comfortably exceeding the 10% growth target.

promises.note: Net working capital to revenue ratio improved to 4.1% in March 2026, beating the 10% target.

promises.note: Q1 FY27 group order inflows grew 14% year-on-year, maintaining full-year growth guidance.
